This property can be set to "auto" (default) or given a numeric value that will correspond to a minimum row height in pixels.

enableRowSelection.description: This flag is used in conjunction with the Column Selection Allowed flag to determine whether not whole-rows, whole-columns, or both (single-cells) are selectable.
